targets.label: YouTube Shorts
targets.notes: IDs are undocumented YouTube internals and rot between app updates. Re-verify with 'adb shell uiautomator dump' when detection degrades. Text-marker fallback requires fullscreen-vertical-video layout corroboration.

targets.label: Instagram Reels
targets.notes: Same ID-rot caveat as YouTube. The Reels tab itself is a surface; the player page is the primary intercept point.

targets.label: TikTok (whole app)
targets.notes: TikTok is all short-form video — there is no meaningful 'TikTok without short videos'. Enabling this switch blocks the app itself. Regional package variants (e.g. com.ss.android.ugc.trill) are NOT yet confirmed; add after verification.

targets.label: Snapchat Spotlight
targets.notes: stories_feed_recycler_view can also match the friends' Stories feed — layout corroboration (fullscreen vertical video) is required before intervening.

targets.label: Facebook Reels
targets.notes: No stable view IDs documented for FB Reels; text-marker + layout corroboration only. Lower confidence — prefer overlay (friction) over back-action here.

shields.note: Whole-app shields via FamilyControls ManagedSettingsStore. Requires the com.apple.developer.family-controls entitlement (gated, per bundle ID). The user picks the actual apps in the system FamilyActivityPicker — tokens are opaque, so these labels are UI hints only, never identifiers.

js_rules.note: Deep-links and in-page taps to /shorts/<id> become regular watch pages.
Selectors rot with YouTube web updates; MutationObserver re-cleans. Desktop selectors included for www fallback.
Navigations into /reels/ or /reel/ are stopped and bounced to the feed.
Instagram's web app is a JS-heavy SPA; selectors need periodic maintenance.

signature.note: Signed at release time. Bundles ship unsigned only in dev builds; the apps must refuse unsigned bundles in release builds. See docs/play-policy.md.
